dedupe_keys.name: south africa steel data genesys mod

description: Jonathan Hanto and colleagues publish South Africa Steel Data for GENeSYS-MOD. The source has no descriptive abstract. Its original title identifies the steel-industry application and its three XLSX descriptors identify hourly steel data, model input data and an employment workbook. These components form one study-specific input collection for modelling industrial energy demand and transition choices. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The metadata does not define the workbook variables, employment methodology, units, scenario years, steel plants or underlying hourly observation period. Coverage is South Africa, with internal aggregation unknown. The related GENeSYS-MOD entry supplies model-family context. The employment workbook is not treated as a general labour-market database. No workbook values were inspected and the resource’s fitness for a particular scenario has not been tested.
